steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In September 2023, a guest on Equity Mates said foreign funds could invest in India by registering with a custodian, naming Citigroup as an example, showing its global custody service enabled market access.

episode.title: Expert: Saurabh Mukherjea - Why you must be investing in India | Marcellus Investment Managers

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2025, Equity Mates reported big US banks, including Citigroup, posted strong quarterly results as dealmaking rebounded and markets boomed, noting Citigroup’s net income rose 18 percent to 3.5 billion amid an improving US regulatory backdrop.

episode.title: Big Bank's Big Warnings, core & satellite is dead & Pimp My Portfolio with Matt Ingram

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In May 2022, Equity Mates noted a prominent investor bought about 55 million Citigroup shares, roughly 3 billion dollars, and contrasted it with an exit from another US bank as rates rose, exploring why they might have seen value in Citigroup at that time.

episode.title: Compare the Pair: Warren Buffett + Cathie Wood are both buying again
